children: WhiteFiber disclosed a 10-year, 40 MW $865M TCV anchor contract with Nscale and reported >$550M in recent cloud contract wins.
Signed 10-year, 40 MW IT-load agreement with Nscale (~$865M total contract value); initial billing began Q3 2026.
Reported recent cloud contract wins aggregating >$550M across owned fleet, project-financed and international deployments.
Data center pipeline of ~1.5 GW with NC-1 Phase 1 contracted (54 MW initial, 99 MW under utility agreement) and two NC sites under purchase agreement.
Completed rapid retrofit case study (MTL-3) delivered in ~6 months with lower buildout cost (~$8M–$10M per gross MW) versus greenfield.
Revenue growth: combined revenue rose to $94.5M LTM Q2 2026 (up 99% vs FY2024); cloud and data center revenue traction noted.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: WhiteFiber unveils $865M Nscale anchor deal, >$550M cloud wins and 1.5GW pipeline
